Numerator:
\[
\cos 5^\circ \cos 20^\circ + \cos 35^\circ \cos 50^\circ - \sin 5^\circ \sin 20^\circ - \sin 35^\circ \sin 50^\circ
\]

Denominator:
\[
\sin 5^\circ \cos 20^\circ - \sin 35^\circ \cos 50^\circ + \cos 5^\circ \sin 20^\circ - \sin 35^\circ \sin 50^\circ
\]

Using the product-to-sum identities:
\[
\cos A \cos B = \frac{1}{2} [\cos(A+B) + \cos(A-B)]
\]
\[
\sin A \sin B = \frac{1}{2} [\cos(A-B) - \cos(A+B)]
\]

Applying these to the numerator:
\[
\cos 5^\circ \cos 20^\circ = \frac{1}{2} [\cos(25^\circ) + \cos(-15^\circ)] = \frac{1}{2} [\cos(25^\circ) + \cos(15^\circ)]
\]
\[
\cos 35^\circ \cos 50^\circ = \frac{1}{2} [\cos(85^\circ) + \cos(-15^\circ)] = \frac{1}{2} [\cos(85^\circ) + \cos(15^\circ)]
\]
\[
-\sin 5^\circ \sin 20^\circ = -\frac{1}{2} [\cos(15^\circ) - \cos(25^\circ)]
\]
\[
-\sin 35^\circ \sin 50^\circ = -\frac{1}{2} [\cos(15^\circ) - \cos(85^\circ)]
\]

Summing these up:
\[
\text{Numerator} = \frac{1}{2} [\cos(25^\circ) + \cos(15^\circ)] + \frac{1}{2} [\cos(85^\circ) + \cos(15^\circ)] - \frac{1}{2} [\cos(15^\circ) - \cos(25^\circ)] - \frac{1}{2} [\cos(15^\circ) - \cos(85^\circ)]
\]
Simplifying, we get:
\[
\text{Numerator} = \cos 25^\circ + \cos 85^\circ
\]

Using the identity \(\cos(90^\circ - x) = \sin(x)\):
\[
\cos 85^\circ = \sin 5^\circ
\]
Thus:
\[
\text{Numerator} = \cos 25^\circ + \sin 5^\circ
\]

Now, for the denominator:
\[
\sin 5^\circ \cos 20^\circ - \sin 35^\circ \cos 50^\circ + \cos 5^\circ \sin 20^\circ - \sin 35^\circ \sin 50^\circ
\]

Using the product-to-sum identities:
\[
\sin 5^\circ \cos 20^\circ = \frac{1}{2} [\sin(25^\circ) + \sin(-15^\circ)] = \frac{1}{2} [\sin(25^\circ) - \sin(15^\circ)]
\]
\[
-\sin 35^\circ \cos 50^\circ = -\frac{1}{2} [\sin(85^\circ) + \sin(-15^\circ)] = -\frac{1}{2} [\sin(85^\circ) - \sin(15^\circ)]
\]
\[
\cos 5^\circ \sin 20^\circ = \frac{1}{2} [\sin(25^\circ) + \sin(-15^\circ)] = \frac{1}{2} [\sin(25^\circ) - \sin(15^\circ)]
\]
\[
-\sin 35^\circ \sin 50^\circ = -\frac{1}{2} [\cos(15^\circ) - \cos(85^\circ)] = -\frac{1}{2} [\cos(15^\circ) - \sin(5^\circ)]
\]

Summing these up:
\[
\text{Denominator} = \frac{1}{2} [\sin(25^\circ) - \sin(15^\circ)] - \frac{1}{2} [\sin(85^\circ) - \sin(15^\circ)] + \frac{1}{2} [\sin(25^\circ) - \sin(15^\circ)] - \frac{1}{2} [\cos(15^\circ) - \sin(5^\circ)]
\]
Simplifying, we get:
\[
\text{Denominator} = \sin 25^\circ + \sin 5^\circ
\]

Thus, the expression simplifies to:
\[
\tan \theta = \frac{\cos 25^\circ + \sin 5^\circ}{\sin 25^\circ + \sin 5^\circ}
\]

Using the identity \(\tan(45^\circ - x) = \frac{1 - \tan x}{1 + \tan x}\), we can see that:
\[
\tan \theta = \tan 40^\circ
\]

Therefore, the least positive angle \(\theta\) is \(40^\circ\).
